scope: Independent AI worker reviews of the finite C077 implementation and evidence tooling. These do not replace pending external release attestations.

reviews.scope: Explicit shared profile/parser/compiler/CLI/scene/GLB adapters and transport/schema compatibility
reviews.conclusion: No shared-profile integration blocker found. Concrete acceptance-checker findings were corrected.

findings.issue: A precision-negative case could pass on a resource failure after evaluation.
findings.resolution: Require a delivered-geometry precision/triangle-format refusal and exclude budget/resource failure.

findings.issue: Three.js ownership began at parent and skipped a one-primitive Mesh carrier.
findings.resolution: Start at the visited node and then climb to the object tag.

reviews.scope: Independent supplied-byte geometry oracle and its actual acceptance call path
reviews.conclusion: Independent edge/triangle contact method is sound for the reviewed finite exact triangles; no production predicate imports. Numeric and coverage gaps were corrected.

findings.issue: Ordinary float crosses cannot independently certify thin-face outward normals or cap orientation.
findings.resolution: Independent exact face/dot signs, scaled normals/area and actual-position exact signed volume before inverse placement.

findings.issue: Actual artifact checks bypassed complete active-scene, one-clip and geometry-free-parent checks.
findings.resolution: Execute check_glb and retain its actual geometry and motion observations.

reviews.scope: Production triangulation, delivery admission, frozen parameters and actual repair workflow
reviews.conclusion: No additional blocker found in independent endpoint caps, fixed strip diagonals, lower outgoing material ownership, snapshots, exact intersections, station gaps or cumulative checks.

findings.issue: Invalid-edit acceptance could accept an unrelated refusal, and validate was only queued/cancelled.
findings.resolution: Bind exact frozen invalid bytes and its diagnostic; execute a successful constructed-level validation as well.

later_runtime_correction.cause: Frozen wrong-station-type expected OKL-E-TYPE; inherited generic quantity coercion returned OKL-E-UNIT.
later_runtime_correction.resolution: Only polygon_section distinguishes a non-Quantity station type from a Quantity with wrong dimension; the latter retains OKL-E-UNIT. Existing coerce and all frozen inputs remain unchanged.
